title: Sumatra 1:250,000 – blad 15

series.title: Sumatra 1:250,000
series.notes: Topographic map series of Sumatra, Indonesia showing roads, railroads and populated places; some sheets also show vegetation, cultivated areas and water features. Relief shown by contours, shading and spot heights. | "Reproductiebedrijf Topografische dienst, Batavia ..." | Copied from Dutch maps (Overzichtskaart van Sumatra) dated 1924-1940. | Published by UK War Office as monochrome reprints in 1941, then as coloured & gridded reprints in 1942. | Published by US Army Map Service (AMS) as gridded reprints in 1942. | Published by South African Survey Company, S.A.E.C., as MDR 572, g

creator: Great Britain. War Office. General Staff. Geographical Section, cartographer. issuing body.
